scope: Six iterations for phone installation, mobile website navigation and installed-app entry

checks.format: passed changed UI and browser scripts

unit_tests.note: First run: 298 passed, 13 skipped after existing PGlite startup hook timed out at 10s. The 13 documents-access tests passed when rerun alone without timeout changes.

checks: Packaged pages share an installable manifest and iPhone/Android icons
Public site navigation reaches a visible QR that independently decodes to the public install URL, downloads and offers device-specific steps
A guest can open installation from mobile welcome, follow direct iPhone steps and show a QR only for a second phone
Android installation prompt opens only after an explicit user click
320px: iPhone guide explains compact and older Safari controls; browser-opening help copies the public URL or offers manual copying without invoking Web Share
390px: iPhone guide explains compact and older Safari controls; browser-opening help copies the public URL or offers manual copying without invoking Web Share
A narrow browser with an unrecognised desktop user agent prioritises phone steps rather than a QR for its own screen
Mobile public navigation opens and closes explicitly, keeps contacts reachable and closes after navigating
An installed guest sees one signup action, no installation promotion, and can continue from the already-installed page directly to login
390px: resume appears before shopping and above the tabs; checklist activities precede optional sharing
390px: installed app uses five patient tabs, preserves shop access and hides redundant install prompts
1280px: resume appears before shopping and above the tabs; checklist activities precede optional sharing
1280px: installed app uses five patient tabs, preserves shop access and hides redundant install prompts
Ordinary browser retains the existing navigation and recommendations tab
Installation link sharing copies only the public link and offers manual copying when clipboard access is denied
Checklist remaining filter preserves progress, announces an in-flight save and prevents duplicate submissions
An already-open app explains connection loss and clears the connection notice after reconnecting
Checklist loading, a failed catalogue with retry, and genuinely missing content have distinct usable states
Returning to the app reloads another device’s checklist progress; failed writes never appear saved and failed reads warn before explicit retry
Real service worker caches only the generic offline page, never assigned document bytes or private navigation
Another account cannot discover the patient’s document in the installed app
An unresponsive update unlocks retry after twenty seconds; late activation does not reload an unsaved profile
A waiting update is explicit and declining the unsaved-change confirmation preserves the edited profile
390px: personal home puts the documents action above the bottom tabs and labels saved readings distinctly from all topics
390px: own-document search, format and reset retain recipient scope and private-page noindex
390px: Studio groups three daily tasks and keeps other tools visible without bypassing the editor workflow
390px: loading/error/cover fallback and missing-reading states are distinct, with accurate runtime page schema
390px: catalogue-empty differs from filter-empty and SPA navigation replaces structured page data
1280px: personal home puts the documents action above the bottom tabs and labels saved readings distinctly from all topics
1280px: own-document search, format and reset retain recipient scope and private-page noindex
1280px: Studio groups three daily tasks and keeps other tools visible without bypassing the editor workflow
1280px: loading/error/cover fallback and missing-reading states are distinct, with accurate runtime page schema
1280px: catalogue-empty differs from filter-empty and SPA navigation replaces structured page data
390px: another account cannot discover the patient's assigned materials through search
320px: patient shortcuts and document filters fit a narrow phone viewport
390: guest starts with account creation; no pre-authentication profile choice or preference write
390: signup waits for confirmation, then explicit parent choice and optional medical step precede the project
1280: direct login resumes explicit partner selection and saves the selected phase without health data
390: confirmed direct entry maps relative to a general path and skips medical questions
390: confirmed direct entry maps friend to a general path and skips medical questions
390: confirmed direct entry maps exploring to a general path and skips medical questions
390: an interrupted parent checkpoint resumes after reload and can finish without personalization
1280: an existing complete profile opens the project without resetting its date, consent or journey from URL parameters
390: confirmation waits for remote preferences before deciding whether onboarding is already complete
390: password recovery stays on password editing and never redirects into signup or project
390: failed remote preference loading blocks onboarding saves instead of overwriting an account with defaults
390: guests earn only a fully checked nonempty checklist badge; unchecking reverses it and writes stay local
1280: account, completed-profile and saved-reading badges count correctly; shares exclude private data and unsaving reverses its badge
390: an authenticated Amazon selection records its own milestone without changing preferences; denied persistence leaves the badge locked and no purchase is claimed

limits: Chromium with emulated viewport, user agent and standalone state; native phone menus are not controlled by these tests.
No real account, patient data or email used; backend requests mocked.
New release not deployed to Cloudflare by the assistant.
v12 and onboarding scenarios ran before the final install-only column alignment adjustment; the PWA suite ran on the exact final package.
